summary:
Live near Blubird Shopping Centre in Birnam or Melrose North? Our workshop at Silvercrest Shopping Centre in Silvamonte is about 6 km away, roughly 12 to 20 minutes via Corlett Drive and Louis Botha Avenue.

We repair front and rear cameras on every iPad, including the LiDAR scanner on iPad Pro models. If your photos are blurry, the camera app shows black, or FaceTime has no picture, we'll find out why.

Every camera job is quoted in writing after a free diagnostic and carries a 6-month warranty. If you can't come to us, we collect from Birnam and Melrose Arch for a flat R300.

Tap Learn more for camera symptoms, directions and prices.
